title: -internal-assembler -fno-PIC: "cannot generate dir32" on any unit with an exception handler
summary: With `-internal-assembler` and `-fno-PIC` together, the compiler stops on any unit with an exception handler with `Fatal error: exception Failure("cannot generate dir32")`. Each option alone compiles it.

actual.text: The compiler stops with `Fatal error: exception Failure("cannot generate dir32")`, exit status 2.

cause: `backend/internal_assembler/relocation_entry.ml`, `create_relocation`, has no case for a 32-bit absolute relocation and fails with an uncaught exception.
